Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

We are hiring for a Capital Formation lead who will be responsible for LP Relationship Management and Fundraising efforts within our asset management business. You will originate and convert new Limited Partners relationships (LP) and grow existing LP relationships. You will own a large prospect book end to end, take opportunities through to serious evaluation on your own, and bring in senior partners to close when needed. You will ideally arrive with an existing book of relationships in at least one LP segment and start closing immediately.

The opportunity

  • Build and cultivate relationships with existing and new LPs. You are the primary point of contact for your LPs, and you drive re-ups, referrals, co-investment and cross-strategy engagement.

  • Own, pioritize and develop new LP relationships at an exceptional level, and run the book independently.

  • Guide investors through the full journey: first meetings and qualification, diligence, negotiation, investment committee approval and signed subscriptions. You convert prospects into serious evaluations yourself.

  • Partner with the deal team on transactions. You bring LPs into transactions and work with the deal team and senior partners to bring them to close.

  • Shape the fundraising plan for your segments, with clear goals, probability-weighted forecasts and conversion metrics.

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs, including performance, research and market data, into clear, persuasive stories for sophisticated investors.

  • Position the firm across investor channels (consultant, institutional, family office and private wealth), and bring leadership market intelligence on allocation trends, investor sentiment and competitive fundraising dynamics.

  • Lead investor communications and experiences, LP meetings, quarterly and annual reporting, conferences and relationship-building events.

  • Oversee external materials, including pitch books, fact sheets, DDQs, data-room content and customized investor requests, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

  • Take on broader investor relations and capital formation work at the director level beyond your own book, as the business needs.

  • Work across the firm. Partner with senior partners and fund leadership, investment and portfolio teams, legal, compliance, investor operations, marketing and fund finance.

  • Close deals from day one. You turn your existing network into commitments quickly, not after a ramp period.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5 to 8 years in investor relations, fundraising, capital formation or institutional sales, ideally in alternative investments, at an asset manager, alternatives firm or fund platform.

  • Ability to talk fluently about venture capital, SPVs, private credit as asset classes and how deals are structured, economics etc.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business or a related field, or equivalent experience. An MBA or CFA is a plus.

  • An established, proven book of LP relationships in at least one segment (for example pensions, endowments, family offices, funds of funds or wealth platforms), and a track record of closing significant capital commitments you can speak to in detail.

  • Experience taking investors through diligence, negotiation and subscription, with working knowledge of fund structures, fee terms and side letters.

  • Experience managing LP relationships after the close, including reporting, communication and re-ups.

  • Ability to run independently as an individual contributor, with the operational discipline to manage a large pipeline largely on your own.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex, incomplete data into clear written and verbal narratives.

  • Executive presence and credibility with CIOs, consultants, senior partners and firm leadership.

  • Judgment on when to escalate and how to use senior partners' and the deal team's time well, with a collaborative, team-first approach.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with digital assets, crypto-native funds or both traditional and digital allocators.

  • Relationships across more than one LP segment.

  • Experience organizing LP events and community initiatives.

  • Experience with CRM and investor-portal tooling (for example Salesforce or Dynamo).

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The UK Financial Services sales team works with some of the largest and most important financial institutions in the UK. We help our users modernise their infrastructure, create better digital experiences for their customers, launch new products, and develop new sources of revenue.

As the banking expert within the UK Financial Services team, you will target net new enterprise business from a named account list comprising some of the UK’s largest Tier 1 banks. You will bring deep knowledge of the banking sector, help shape Stripe’s approach to the market, and navigate complex, highly regulated organisations to build relationships with senior stakeholders across business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, procurement, and finance.

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do

The UK Financial Services sales team works across the financial services sector, helping leading institutions modernise legacy infrastructure, improve customer experiences, expand their digital capabilities, and identify new opportunities for growth.

As the banking expert within the team, you will develop new relationships within a named list of Tier 1 UK banks. You will identify high value use cases for Stripe, build compelling transformation and commercial cases, and lead complex opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation and close. You will also help strengthen our understanding of the banking market and shape how Stripe positions its products and capabilities with major banks.

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Own a named account list of Tier 1 UK banks and develop detailed account plans for winning and expanding business across complex organisations
  • Act as the banking expert within the UK Financial Services team, sharing market insight and helping colleagues navigate the sector
  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outbound engagement and use case discovery through business case development, deal structuring, negotiation, and close
  • Design and execute sales strategies suited to the extended decision making, budgeting, procurement, risk, and regulatory processes of large financial institutions
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders and senior leaders across business, technology, digital, operations, finance, risk, compliance, legal, and procurement
  • Navigate complex stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus between commercial sponsors, technical teams, control functions, and executive decision makers
  • Identify and develop new use cases for Stripe across customer propositions, digital channels, financial operations, and new business models
  • Translate banks’ strategic priorities and technical requirements into compelling, multi product solutions and clear commercial outcomes
  • Coordinate closely with Solutions Architecture, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and other internal teams throughout the sales process
  • Lead deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex, and strategically important agreements
  • Build and maintain a strong understanding of the UK banking landscape, including market dynamics, technology priorities, regulatory considerations, and competitive developments
  • Bring structured feedback from banks and prospects to Stripe’s Product and GTM teams, helping to inform our product roadmap, value proposition, and market positioning
  • Contribute to team initiatives that refine our financial services sales methodology, account planning approach, playbooks, and best practices
  • Maintain a high quality pipeline and consistently deliver against ambitious revenue targets

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic business development, or senior commercial roles
  • A track record of top performance and of securing complex, strategic enterprise agreements
  • Ability to navigate complex, highly regulated organisations and build credibility with senior stakeholders
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units, functions, and executive relationships
  • Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and develop solutions across multiple products
  • Strong understanding of complex buying cycles, procurement frameworks, budgeting processes, governance requirements, and decision making structures
  • Proven ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders, including senior executives, technology teams, business leaders, risk and compliance functions, and procurement
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial, legal, technical, and operational requirements
  • Strong business case development skills, with the ability to connect technology investments to strategic, customer, operational, and financial outcomes
  • Excellent presentation skills, particularly in executive and in person meetings involving multiple stakeholders
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a highly ambiguous, fast paced, and cross functional environment
  • A strategic and analytical approach to developing a market, combined with the creativity and persistence required to open new opportunities
  • Strong interest in technology and its potential to transform banking and financial services

Preferred requirements

  • Experience in one or both of the following:
    • Working within a Tier 1 bank, with direct exposure to its commercial, technology, digital, or transformation priorities
    • Selling complex enterprise technology solutions into Tier 1 banks
  • An extensive network of senior relationships across the UK banking sector
  • Deep knowledge of how large banks evaluate, procure, and implement new technology
  • Familiarity with the operational, risk, compliance, legal, and procurement requirements involved in banking transformation programmes
  • A track record of closing complex, seven figure plus enterprise deals
  • Experience acting as a banking specialist or subject matter expert within a broader sales team

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

Alpaca is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Tokenization Analyst to join our Tokenization department.

This individual will work directly with the General Manager of Tokenization, supporting the development, commercialization, and execution of Alpaca's tokenization strategy.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, product, business development, and operations. The ideal candidate is a versatile problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity, and is comfortable taking ownership of projects from conception through execution.

This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to multiple facets of a rapidly emerging industry while helping build the infrastructure powering the future of tokenized financial markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Business Operations

  • Work directly with the GM of Tokenization to execute the department's strategic priorities and business objectives.
  • Track key departmental initiatives, product milestones, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring accountability and timely execution.
  • Monitor departmental KPIs and develop recurring reporting on business performance, including revenue, transaction volumes, partner adoption, and other strategic metrics.
  • Prepare executive presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.
  • Support annual and quarterly planning, including prioritization, business case development, and resource planning.
  • Lead special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by the GM.

Product & Go-to-Market Enablement

  • Partner closely with Product teams to develop sales collateral, product presentations, integration guides, FAQs, and other client-facing materials.
  • Translate complex technical product capabilities into clear, compelling commercial narratives for prospective clients and partners.
  • Support product launches by coordinating internal readiness, external communications, and go-to-market deliverables.
  • Gather feedback from Sales, partners, and ecosystem participants to help inform product strategy and prioritization.

Market Research & Ecosystem Development

  • Conduct in-depth research on the global tokenization ecosystem, including token issuers, blockchain networks, exchanges, broker-dealers, market makers, custodians, and other infrastructure providers.
  • Identify, research, and evaluate prospective clients, strategic partners, and emerging commercial opportunities.
  • Monitor competitive developments, market trends, regulatory changes, and technological innovations impacting tokenized securities.
  • Develop market maps, competitive analyses, and strategic recommendations to support business development and product decisions.

Commercial & Partnership Support

  • Support the evaluation and execution of strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare partner briefings, meeting materials, commercial proposals, and supporting analyses.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout partnership discussions, integrations, and launches.
  • Track commercial opportunities, partnership progress, and follow-up actions to help accelerate execution.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as a central point of coordination across Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Compliance, and Operations for key tokenization initiatives.
  • Proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies, escalating issues and recommending solutions.
  • Establish and improve internal reporting, documentation, and operating processes to increase departmental efficiency.

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in strategy, business operations, product, consulting, financial services, fintech, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create polished presentations and communicate complex concepts clearly.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management abilities, with strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate stakeholders, and independently drive projects forward.
  • Strong proficiency in spreadsheets, presentations, and analytical tools.
  • Genuine interest in financial markets, digital assets, blockchain technology, and tokenization.

Preferred

  • Experience in capital markets, brokerage infrastructure, fintech, digital assets, or blockchain-related businesses.
  • Familiarity with securities markets, market structure, trading, clearing, custody, or settlement.
  • Exposure to tokenized securities, stablecoins, DeFi, or blockchain infrastructure.
  • Experience working closely with senior executives or within a strategy, business operations, or Chief of Staff function.
  • Experience developing business cases, financial models, KPI dashboards, or commercial analyses.

What Success Looks Like

  • Key departmental initiatives are clearly tracked, with proactive identification and resolution of blockers.
  • Product and Sales teams have high-quality, up-to-date materials to support commercialization and partner integrations.
  • Leadership has consistent visibility into departmental performance, strategic priorities, and execution progress.
  • New partnership opportunities and ecosystem developments are systematically evaluated and translated into actionable recommendations.
  • The GM and broader Tokenization team can operate more effectively, with greater coordination, faster decision-making, and stronger execution.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

About zerohash

zerohash powers the infrastructure that lets businesses embed digital assets into their products. Our APIs and embedded infrastructure enable banks, brokerages, fintechs, trading firms, and other financial institutions to launch crypto and stablecoin experiences without building the underlying infrastructure, licensing, or operations themselves. zerohash is a registered money services business across the U.S. and holds VASP registrations in the EU, and other jurisdictions.

About the role

We are looking for a pre-sales Solutions Engineer to own the technical side of our institutional trading deals. You will be the person a bank, broker-dealer, or trading firm talks to when they want to understand how zerohash connects to their trading stack: FIX sessions, order books, RFQ, market data, settlement, and the APIs around them.

You will partner with Account Executives from first meeting to signature. You will run discovery, design the solution, demo the platform, answer RFPs and due diligence questionnaires, and earn the trust of technical and business stakeholders at regulated institutions. Once a deal signs, you hand a clear, well documented solution to our Implementation Services team and stay close to the account for expansion opportunities.

Success in this role is measured by deals won, by how quickly prospects move from first call to a signed agreement, and by how few surprises Implementation finds after signature.

What you will do

  • Lead technical discovery with banks, broker-dealers, wealth platforms, and trading firms to understand their order flow, trading workflows, existing OMS/EMS setup, connectivity, and settlement needs.
  • Explain and demo how zerohash fits into an institutional trading stack, including FIX connectivity for order entry, execution reports and drop copy, central limit order book (CLOB) and RFQ execution, market data, and the REST APIs and webhooks around them.
  • Design end-to-end solutions that combine trading with adjacent products such as account funding, payouts, crypto deposits and withdrawals, and staking, and document them in solution designs and flow diagrams that both the client and our internal teams can rely on.
  • Lead executive presentations and technical deep dives for audiences ranging from heads of e-trading and CTOs to operations, risk, and compliance teams. Adjust the depth of the conversation to the room.
  • Own the technical response to RFPs, RFIs, vendor due diligence, and information security questionnaires, working with Security, Compliance, and Legal where needed.
  • Run proof-of-value demos and scope certification testing so prospects can validate connectivity before they sign.
  • Qualify deals with your Account Executive. Identify technical blockers, product gaps, and regulatory constraints early, and help shape the commercial proposal.
  • Bring structured feedback from the market to Product and Engineering, and help prioritize the capabilities that win institutional deals.
  • Hand off signed deals to Implementation Services with a complete solution design, then support upsell and expansion conversations with existing clients.
  • Build reusable pre-sales assets such as demo scripts, reference architectures, FIX onboarding materials, and an RFP answer library, and help Account Executives spot good-fit opportunities.

What you bring

  • 4+ years (6+ for Senior) in a pre-sales technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Pre-Sales Consultant, with a track record of helping win new business.
  • Experience selling, demoing, or supporting FIX-based trading connectivity for institutional clients, on the sell side, buy side, or at a trading technology vendor. You can explain sessions, order entry, execution reports, drop copy, and market data with confidence.
  • Working knowledge of market structure and trading workflows: order types, order books, RFQ, OMS/EMS, pre-trade checks, and post-trade settlement.
  • Experience selling to or working with banks, broker-dealers, or other regulated financial institutions, including navigating their procurement, security review, and compliance processes.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, REST, webhooks, and how data moves between systems. Comfortable reading API documentation and walking a client developer through an integration.
  • Excellent presentation and written communication. You can whiteboard a FIX flow for an engineer and then explain the business value to a managing director.
  • Hands-on familiarity with crypto, for example using wallets, exchanges, or stablecoins, and a strong drive to become an expert in digital assets and blockchain technology.
  • A passion for learning. You pick up new products and technologies quickly and enjoy a fast-paced environment where priorities change.
  • Fluency with AI tools in your daily work, including AI-assisted coding (vibe coding) to build demos, prototypes, and scripts, answer technical questions, and prepare for client meetings. We care about the results, not how you get there.
  • Ability to manage several active deals at once with minimal oversight.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience with digital asset trading, custody, settlement, staking, stablecoins, or tokenized assets.
  • Background at an exchange, prime broker, electronic trading desk, or OMS/EMS or FIX engine vendor.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory context of trading for U.S. and EU institutions, such as broker-dealer obligations or MiFID II trade reporting.
  • Experience with SQL and a scripting language such as Python, JavaScript, or Go to build demos, test connectivity, or analyze data.

Why join

  • Work on the infrastructure that banks and brokerages use to bring digital assets to millions of end users.
  • High visibility role with direct impact on revenue and on what we build next.
  • Work alongside a team with deep experience across trading, payments, and crypto infrastructure.

Benefits

We believe a happy, motivated, and healthy team is the best way to succeed. We offer the following benefits:

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

About Tether

Tether is a pioneer in digital asset technology, financial freedom, and decentralized infrastructure. Beyond developing USD₮—the world’s most liquid and widely adopted digital dollar—Tether has expanded into a multi-pillar technology powerhouse across Finance, Data & AI, Telecommunications, and Energy Infrastructure.


We build modular, resilient, and sovereign technology designed to empower businesses, developers, and individuals without centralized gatekeepers:

  • Tether AI & QVAC: Edge-computing, decentralized, and open-architecture AI systems engineered to run locally and modularly across distributed networks.

  • Wallet Development Kit (WDK by Tether): A modular, self-custodial wallet toolkit designed to integrate digital dollars, Bitcoin, and programmable digital asset rails into mobile, web, desktop, and autonomous AI agents.

  • Keet & Pear Runtime: Serverless, end-to-end encrypted, peer-to-peer communication tools and application frameworks that operate without intermediary infrastructure.

Our core products are production-ready. A dedicated global go-to-market team sources leads, develops opportunities, and supports their conversion into LOIs and MOUs. Implementation is then delivered with the support of external Systems Integrators (SIs), developer firms, and digital engineering consultancies, a global network we are establishing to build on this stack and deploy our technologies in large-scale enterprise environments.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

Role Overview

As Head of Systems Integrators & Technical Alliances, you will design, launch, and scale Tether’s global developer integration and SI partner program. Large enterprises, financial institutions, and platforms do not always build integrations in-house—they turn to elite technical consultancies, digital agencies, and systems integrators to customize and implement software. Your mandate is to recruit, enable, and incentivize these technical agencies to build dedicated practices around Tether’s tech stack (AI, WDK, and P2P communication suites).

Responsibilities

1. Program Architecture

  • Architect the SI and Developer Partner Program framework, including partner tiers, accreditation standards, commercial arrangements, and co-delivery governance.

  • Define the SLA for the different tiers of partners to support the implementation of projects that are sourced primarily by our go-to-market team.

  • Design the requirements that partners need to have in terms of allocated resources, training of developers to be part and progress in the program

  • Establish partner operations, lifecycle workflows, sandbox access protocols, and developer enablement tracks.

  • Land, onboard, and activate the inaugural cohort of certified SI partners.


3. Developer Enablement & Technical Governance

  • Act as a technical liaison between partners and Tether’s Product and Engineering teams—translating our APIs, SDKs, and developer kits (WDK, QVAC, Pear Runtime) into partner-ready reference architectures, while capturing real-world developer feedback from SIs to directly inform and drive product roadmap improvements.

  • Develop a rigorous, lightweight technical certification process to ensure partner engineering teams meet Tether's high standards for security, speed, and reliability.

  • Act as the operational bridge between Tether's core engineering teams and external agency developers to eliminate integration friction.


4. Delivery Velocity & Deployment Quality

  • Delivery Velocity: Systematically reduce the cycle time required for an external SI to take an enterprise customer from integration kick-off to production go-live.

  • Deployment Quality: Monitor code maintainability, security compliance, client satisfaction, and post-launch stability across all partner-delivered projects.

  • Define future hiring plans and lead the recruitment of future team members.

Must-Haves

  • 6+ Years in Technical Alliances & SI Programs: Proven experience establishing or scaling Systems Integrator programs, Technical Partner ecosystems, or Solution Partner networks at high-growth developer-first platforms, API providers, or enterprise software companies.

  • 0-to-1 Track Record: Demonstrable experience building a technical partner program from scratch, rolling up your sleeves to sign the first partners, and defining operational playbooks.

  • Strong Technical Fluency: Deep architectural comprehension of APIs, SDKs, developer tooling, cryptographic/wallet protocols, and modern software deployment models. You can speak credibly with agency CTOs, enterprise architects, and senior software engineers.

  • Agency Business Acumen: Clear understanding of how professional services firms, engineering agencies, and SIs operate (billable utilization, practice development, implementation margin).

  • High Ownership & Adaptability: Experience working directly with C-suite executives in lean, high-velocity environments with minimal bureaucracy.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with self-custodial digital wallets, Bitcoin/stablecoin financial infrastructure, decentralized edge AI, or peer-to-peer (P2P) communication architectures.

  • An existing network of boutique digital engineering firms, software development consultancies, and systems integrators in the US, Europe, or emerging markets.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Who You Are

Compensation costs are a key driver of profitability for the data center business given revenues are contracted for 15-year periods and operating costs are passed through to tenants. This role will own the allocation, analysis and reporting of that information across data halls, between construction and operations, recoveries, etc. Within the Data Center team, you are a detail-oriented CPA with a genuine appetite for analysis. You will be trusted with highly confidential employee compensation information which you will handle with absolute discretion. Analysis & Insight

Capital markets still settle on infrastructure built decades ago. Trillions of dollars in fund assets sit idle in settlement delays and collateral buffers because no rail can move legal title in real time. We are building that rail on the XRP Ledger, and it is already live: tokenized funds exist on XRPL today as Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs), moving as collateral across issuance, distribution and repo with some of the world's largest asset managers and custodians.

You will own the two protocol workstreams that decide how far this goes.

Token standards. MPTs need to grow from a fund token into a complete issuance framework for institutions: asset restrictions, corporate events, programmable behavior. Get this right and the next wave of assets (commercial paper, commodities, bonds, equities) can be issued, held and mobilized natively on a public ledger. Each asset class brings its own rules, and you will determine what fits within the protocol and what remains outside it.

Privacy. Institutions will not trade on a ledger where every position is visible. Confidential MPT brings capital-markets-grade confidentiality to a public chain. You will be responsible for its progress from initial rollout to enterprise-wide adoption. This covers keeping up with new emerging technologies and industry trends, and working with custodians and wallets supporting development into vaults and payments. These are open problems across the industry. Few teams anywhere in the world are working on all of them at once.

This is a role where you witness your impact directly. The specifications you write become amendments to an open-source ledger, adopted by the XRPL validators community and used by real institutions moving real money. You will work alongside protocol engineers, cryptographers, custodians and issuers, with the backing of a team that has already brought the first institutional funds on-chain.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead the tokenization roadmap for XRPL: MPT evolution, transfer controls, corporate actions and programmable tokens, and decide what belongs in the protocol versus above it.
  • Lead the privacy roadmap: take Confidential MPTs from mainnet launch to institutional scale, including key rotation and recovery, performance targets and confidential vaults.
  • Generate new feature specifications and build the consensus behind them, working with Ripple engineering, XRPL validators and open-source contributors to carry proposals from concept to amendment.
  • Set the requirements and priorities for each new asset class, and shape the go-to-market that brings capital markets participants onto XRPL.

  • Scope the compliance capabilities that regulated issuers need to meet their obligations on XRPL.
  • Partner with developer growth and documentation teams so institutions can originate assets on XRPL without a Ripple engineer in the room.
  • Define the metrics that show the work is landing: XRPL's share of tokenized assets, issuance volume and ecosystem integrations.

In your first 90 days, you will take charge of a single roadmap across tokenization and privacy and know every open item on it. By the end of your first year, you will have successfully delivered the next generation of tokenization capabilities. And outlined what institutional privacy on XRPL entails.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

About Open Standard

Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount.

Our flagship product, Open USD (OUSD), is a stablecoin built for the internet. It's live on Ethereum, Base, Solana, and Tempo, with Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe, and Visa as founding partners and 200+ companies in our network.

We're a lean team in San Francisco and New York, led by Zach Abrams, who co-founded Bridge and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.

About the Role

We're hiring our Banking and Financial Institutions Lead: the person who brings OUSD to banks, asset managers, exchanges and the rest of traditional finance.

This is a sales role, and a long-term bet. Our model should change how dollars move through the financial system, and that change runs through institutions that move carefully. You'll plug OUSD into flows that either don't exist yet or that we're replacing, which means long, education-heavy cycles with many counterparties at the table.

You'll own a large surface area of banks and capital markets firms, mostly on your own from day one. That means daily meetings with institutions, learning fast what works and what doesn't, and seeing complex deals through to signature.

What You'll Do

  • Own OS's relationships with banks, asset managers, exchanges, and capital markets players.

  • Build and run a pipeline of institutional deals from first meeting to signed agreement.

  • Represent Open Standard with senior leaders at large financial institutions.

  • Map every deal's counterparties (business sponsors, risk, compliance, legal, treasury, operations, technology) and get each of them to yes.

  • Shape use cases with partners, such as stablecoin settlement, collateral, and treasury flows, and turn them into a clear value proposition.

  • Educate institutions on stablecoins and OUSD, and turn their objections into product and policy feedback for the team.

  • Work closely with our capital markets, partnerships, policy, and product teams.

  • Help define how we sell to TradFi as the team grows.

Who You Are

  • 7 to 15 years selling to banks and other financial institutions, with a track record of closing large, complex deals.

  • You know how banks buy: who signs, who can block, how risk and compliance reviews work, and how long it really takes.

  • Fluent in institutional and trading-focused clients, and in the language of Wall Street and TradFi.

  • A strong network across banks and capital markets, and the credibility to get a meeting with senior decision makers.

  • Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, or payments infrastructure.

  • Polished in the room, scrappy outside it. You drive deals forward even when the other side moves slowly.

  • Comfortable working with a high degree of independence and no existing playbook.

  • Low ego, high ownership, and direct.

  • Already using AI tools in how you research, prepare, and sell.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a stablecoin issuer, digital asset custodian, or crypto infrastructure company selling to banks.

  • Time inside a bank or broker-dealer, in addition to selling to them.

  • Knowledge of settlement, collateral, and market structure at exchanges and clearinghouses.

  • Familiarity with the US regulatory landscape for stablecoins and bank activities.
